test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who arranges and sells cut flowers
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Florist**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A florist's job is related to flowers including selling and pruning.
 
• For Example, ***a Florist plays an important role in weddings***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A flautist** is **a musician** who uses a flute.
 
• **Gardner **is a person who **maintains a garden**, unlike a florist who sells flowers, a gardener only tends to the garden.
 
• **A grocer** is a person **who sells food** and other household items.
